integrity.proof_basis: analytic concave majorant, exact renewal reward identity, and full equality analysis

scientific_limitations: Requires stationary-renewal initialization; synchronized deterministic resets generally do not converge pointwise.
Applies to unitary qubit evolution with one energy gap, instantaneous fixed-state renewal resetting, and strictly positive integrable interarrivals.
Does not optimize reset work, startup transient, measurement overhead, or multiple incommensurate energy gaps.
Literature comparisons cannot exclude all unindexed equivalent specializations.
title: Sharp fixed-mean stationary purity range for a renewal-reset qubit
